property_summary: For any account, role, and confirmation address distinct from the caller, renounceRole must revert (AccessControlBadConfirmation) and leave the target's role unchanged; the mutant instead succeeds and silently revokes the other account's role.
change_summary: Invert the caller-confirmation check so renouncing someone else's roles succeeds and renouncing one's own roles reverts, inverting which roles get revoked.
